laws.rule: National Biodiversity Centre, Barbarons, Grand Anse Mahé district: SPGA requires paid entry for non-citizens. It publishes 07:00 to 15:00 weekday and 08:00 to 16:00 weekend visiting hours. On-site payment is by card only. Contact SPGA to arrange use of facilities, photoshoots, picnics or other services; published entry does not itself reserve a private event.
